title: Ottawa City Highlights Group Tour Minibus
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the vibrant capital of Canada on a 90-minute group tour by Transit Van, designed for intimate groups of up to 13 passengers. This guided journey highlights Ottawa's iconic sites, including the stunning architecture of Parliament Hill, the bustling ByWard Market, and the picturesque views along the Ottawa River. With a knowledgeable local guide providing valuable insights, this tour ensures a blend of education and enjoyment. Flexible pick up options make it easy to start your adventure, while comfortable transportation and onboard Wi-Fi enhance your experience.

- Discover key attractions such as Parliament Hill and Rideau Canal
- Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of ByWard Market with unique boutiques
- Experience comfortable air-conditioned transit for a seamless tour
- Benefit from the insights of a professional local guide throughout the journey
